digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today’s dashboard still shows the day’s work in motion, with Amazon Connect and Attorney Review carrying the most immediate risk into Friday.

items.label: Set the Amazon Connect recovery and rollout-readiness plan
items.detail: Two blockers remain open and Denver is still pending. Confirm the next Salesforce diagnostic and owner, the user-and-skills audit ETA, capacity for later rollout waves, and a clear stakeholder reporting cadence.

items.label: Close Incident Response communications ownership
items.detail: Confirm the Bucket 6 notification trigger, the communications owner, and any remaining guide inputs so the handoff has clear ownership.

items.label: Close the Attorney Review coverage, training, and routing decisions
items.detail: Confirm coverage for the overlapping working session and one-on-ones, name the training-roster owner and October 12 or 13 deadline, and settle the open questions about ticket field automation and reassignment back to the original attorney.

items.label: Verify the Legal Request Tool launch and support path
items.detail: A test request was created successfully today. Confirm the launch message was sent and that process questions route to Raquel while bugs route through Halo to Madhu.

items.label: Review the open project security alert
items.detail: Identify the affected project and vulnerability, confirm whether exposure is active, and assign a remediation owner and due date.

items.label: Decide Idalia’s Client Services access request
items.detail: Confirm the business need and appropriate SharePoint permission level, then approve or decline the request.

items.label: Review Claude’s updated GitHub permissions request
items.detail: Confirm the additional permissions are expected and appropriately scoped before approving the GitHub App request.

items.label: Complete the overdue harassment-prevention training
items.detail: Rippling still lists the Dominican Republic EOR course as overdue. Complete it or confirm with HR why it remains assigned.

items.label: Plan the five downward reviews
items.detail: The reviews are due October 15. Reserve writing time and gather input from previous managers where required.

items.label: SMS automation is moving into rebaselining
items.detail: Laura confirmed the short pause is ending: the team is rebaselining the project and aligning stakeholders and the vendor so the first item can move again.

items.label: 9:00 AM - Jean and Sara 1:1, followed by Jhara at 9:30 AM
items.detail: Use the two conversations to clear escalation, process-map, roster, and training decisions before the Attorney Review working session.

items.label: 10:00 AM - Attorney Review overlaps the 10:30 AM Amazon Connect standup
items.detail: Choose coverage so both the October 15 launch work and the deployment checkpoint return clear decisions. The Salesforce Program Standup scheduled for 10:30 AM is canceled.

items.label: 12:00 PM - Protected work time before the EPMO management meeting
items.detail: Use the noon block for follow-through, then bring unresolved priorities and risks into the 1:00 PM management meeting.

items.label: 2:30 PM - Project pipeline into the executive status update
items.detail: Prepare priority changes, UAT decisions, and executive-slide updates before the 2:30 PM and 3:00 PM sequence.
